messages:
sarah-cs: Hi team — acme-corp (org: acme-123) ping. Their Console shows 500 trial credits under org billing but all API requests using service key sk-****-prod return 402 Payment Required. Customer says UI shows credits available and the project-level usage tab is empty. Can someone triage?

raj-support: Thanks Sarah. Can you paste the exact service key id (last 8 chars) and project id? Also did they create any new project recently or migrate orgs?

sarah-cs: Project id: proj_84KG7. Service key last 8: prodA9BZ. They migrated a couple of weeks ago from a sandbox org -> main org. No recent projects created today.

miguel-eng: I can look. Quick repro command you ran?

sarah-cs: I ran a simple curl against text-generation endpoint, getting 402. Here's redacted output: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"test"}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "billing_error",
    "message": "Insufficient credits for request",
    "code": "insufficient_credits"
  }
}
```

raj-support: Console screenshot of billing page (customer attached) shows org-level credits: 500 trial credits, expiry 2026-04-10. But service key usage page shows 0 credits applied and requests billed. Looks like credits are not propagating to that service key/project.

billing-bot: Promo applied: TRIAL_500_2026_03_01 -> org: acme-123, id: promo-77f. Last sync: 2026-03-03T02:13:08Z. Sync status: FAILED (code: mapping_conflict).

jen-sre: mapping_conflict usually means the org->project mapping changed after promo grant. The resync job fails if it detects ambiguous project attachments. I can check the sync logs.

miguel-eng: Can you paste the sync job log lines around the failure? We need to know which mapping conflict triggered it.

jen-sre: Copying relevant lines from jobs-billing.log at 2148000000: 
```
[2026-03-01T02:12:45Z] billing-sync: starting promo propagation for promo-77f
[2026-03-01T02:12:46Z] billing-sync: org acme-123 -> candidate projects: proj_84KG7, proj_OLD12
[2026-03-01T02:12:46Z] billing-sync: ERROR mapping_conflict: multiple active projects for org grant, abort to avoid double-apply
```

miguel-eng: Ah — so after org migration there's a stale project proj_OLD12 still marked active which blocks automated propagation. That would leave the promo at org-level but not attached to any single service key/project. API billing checks per-service-key do not see promo, hence 402.

raj-support: Customer asked for an ETA and workaround. They need immediate access for a demo tonight.

sarah-cs: They'd like a manual resync if possible or a one-off grant to proj_84KG7.

jen-sre: I can do a manual resync by clearing the ambiguous project flag for proj_OLD12. Before I touch production, confirm that proj_OLD12 is indeed deprecated and that no active keys are using it.

raj-support: @customer-ops can you confirm proj_OLD12 is safe to deprecate? Customer-ops: any active deployment or service keys tied to proj_OLD12?

customer-ops: proj_OLD12 was from our old POC and has no live keys. Safe to deprecate.

jen-sre: OK I'm running a manual resync now. Steps: 1) set proj_OLD12.active=false 2) run billing-sync --promo promo-77f --org acme-123 --force-propagate 3) verify per-project credits.

[~10m later]

jen-sre: Manual resync completed. billing-sync reports: propagated promo-77f -> proj_84KG7 (500 credits).

billing-bot: Promo propagation event recorded: promo-77f applied to proj_84KG7 at 2026-03-04T03:10:21Z.

miguel-eng: Can we confirm customer-facing API now returns 200 and tokens are deducted from promo pool? Sarah, can you ask them to re-run the same curl?

sarah-cs: Customer retried and shared output: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "id": "gen_01",
  "choices": [...]
}
```
Also their Console now shows project usage decrementing against the 500 promo pool.

raj-support: Great. Please do postmortem notes and flag for billing reliability. This is likely to recur when orgs have stale projects after migrations.

miguel-eng: I'll open a follow-up ticket to add a pre-check in billing-sync to auto-suggest resolution for mapping_conflict (e.g., surface potentially-stale projects to admins rather than abort).

sarah-cs: Customer notified and extremely relieved. Marking as resolved for now, but leaving ticket open for eng follow-up. :thumbsup:

jen-sre: Follow-up actions: 1) Add admin CLI to list ambiguous projects for an org (P0), 2) Add soft-apply path with admin confirmation in billing-sync (P1), 3) Alerting on repeated mapping_conflict errors (P2).

miguel-eng: Assigned to miguel-eng (P0) + jen-sre (P1) + billing infra. I'll put estimated ETA: 2-3 sprints for full automation, short-term CLI in 3 working days.

sarah-cs: Thanks all — closing thread once follow-up ticket created.

raj-support: Ticket created: BL-4621 "promo propagation fails on org->project mapping conflict". Link: https://redwood.example/issue/BL-4621

customer-ops: Thanks everyone!
